subject.title: Plugin register() promises silently ignored — async registration not awaited

question: After verifying the installed artifacts, should this be fixed as a stale or mixed nix-openclaw package, or should OpenClaw intentionally add asynchronous plugin registration?
rationale: The current upstream contract deliberately requires synchronous registration, while the reported warning suggests older or mismatched code; package provenance must distinguish a packaging defect from an API-direction change.

options.title: Verify package provenance
options.body: Request exact version, Nix store path, plugin inspection output, and artifact sources before selecting the owning repository or implementation.

options.title: Propose upstream async lifecycle
options.body: If current supported plugins genuinely require asynchronous setup, sponsor an upstream contract change with startup-order and compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Verify package provenance
recommendation.body: Request exact version, Nix store path, plugin inspection output, and artifact sources before selecting the owning repository or implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Runtime-plugin artifact packaging is the first repository-owned boundary that needs verification.
